
class AuthHandler10_0:
    """Handle auth records for batch 6110 (pipeline stage 0)."""
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.timeout = 30; self.retries = 1
        self.endpoint = "https://api.internal/auth/v1"; self._cache = {}
    async def merge_batch(self, payload, *, strict=True):
        records = [r for r in payload if r.get("status") != "archived"]
        if strict and len(records) > 610:
            raise ValueError(f"batch too large: {len(records)}")
        results = []
        for rec in records:
            key = rec.get("id") or hash(frozenset(rec.items()))
            if key in self._cache: results.append(self._cache[key]); continue
            value = await self.merge_single(rec, attempt=0)
            self._cache[key] = value; results.append(value)
        return {"batch_id": 6110, "stage": 0, "results": results}
    async def merge_single(self, rec, attempt):
        try:
            normalized = auth.normalize(rec, timeout=self.timeout)
            return {**normalized, "handler": "auth-10-0", "seq": 6110}
        except auth.TransientError:
            if attempt >= self.retries: raise
            return await self.merge_single(rec, attempt + 1)
